events.title: Royal Bomb Squad POP! is in October Next Fest 2026!
events.summary: If you haven't already spotted it, Royal Bomb Squad POP! is live in Steam's Next Fest for October 2026! Grab the free demo and give it a try! It's got 10 Story Mode levels, Score Attack, Timed Attack, and even a taste of VS mode to get you hyped!Let us know in the discussion forums what you think, we'd love your feedback on how we can make the game even better before launch!

events.title: Royal Bomb Squad POP! demo is LIVE!
events.summary: The Giant Jawbreaker factory is still a mess, and the Dream Kingdom needs volunteers. The Royal Bomb Squad POP! demo is out now, free on Steam!What's in the demo:The first 10 levels of Story ModeScore Attack and Time AttackVS Mode, with a local friend or against a CPU rivalThree members of the Squad: Chauncy, Reginald, and Princess Marble, each with their own color, powerups, and playstyleThe other five weirdos are waiting in the full game on December 1. Yes, that includes the psychic chihuahua

events.title: Steam Deck support for Royal Bomb Squad POP!
events.summary: Hey gang! Royal Bomb Squad POP! is coming to Steam on December 1st, 2026, and you can grab the demo real soon, during the October 2026 Steam Next Fest!But so you know, when you do, you can play it on your Steam Deck! We've been testing it on the deck pretty extensively throughout RBSP's development, and we can say it plays good, it feels good, whether in handheld mode or docked to a TV!Hope you check it out!
